Results 2026-09-16: hello none; orders 12 of 12 non-vacuous (acting-bounded-by-ownership fires in 6 of 7 environments, the rest in 1); reservations 15 of 15 non-vacuous (only-employees-acted-for in all 14, possession-writes-named-record-only and writes-require-pair-or-specialist in 6, the rest in 2 or 4). acceptance_criteria: A ranked written report in the task notes with a concrete fix per finding.
notes:
Fresh-clone review, 2026-09-16, Opus agent with no context. Ranked.

Blocks a newcomer
1. README's first command, check usecases/hello, exits 1 on a Python-only machine at the prove gate (cvc5 missing); the caveat is the last line of the README. Fix: caveat under the check block; say the first three gates pass without Rust/cvc5.
2. learn/index.html promises four passing steps and never mentions cvc5. Fix: one clause pointing at the proofs page and install note.
3. Every entry point out of the README is a raw .html file; no GitHub Pages, so github.com shows source. Fix: publish Pages or say "clone and open in a browser". (Pages is Sam's decision: follow-up task.)

Friction
4. README describes designs/ as "plans for work not yet done" but reorganization.md is the finished plan for the current layout.
5. "corpus" arrives undefined in hello.html; define it once at the first "nine cases".
6. check-access on hello prints no Writable section though the README promises "every writable field" (hello grants no writers). Point the example at orders or drop the phrase.
7. hello.html's folder table omits principals.cedarschema, actions.cedarschema, build.py, tests/events/, tests/test_*.py.
8. check.sh is never named in the README.
9. validate's cedarpy message reads like a second missing prerequisite; soften.
10. history/index.html says core/ three times; there is no core/.
11. index.html says "three commands" (README has four); history/index.html says ten iterations live under history/ (nine directories).
12. usecases/orders and usecases/reservations have no README pointing back to their learn step.
13. Agent bookkeeping (.beads/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .agents/, .codex/, .claude/) is unexplained in the root listing.

Worked well: every command and count was right; the break-it edit failed exactly the two cases named; dry-run output is the clearest artifact; zero broken links; proofs.html section 4 honest; guide.html section 1's six questions are the best on-ramp.
close_reason: report in notes; twelve findings fixed in commit, Pages follow-up filed
